verdict.rationale: Pipecat markets 'ultra-low latency' and backs it with a dedicated STT latency tuning guide. That guide ships measured P99 latency values per STT service and defines the Time To Final Segment metric, and built-in metrics plus community-cited Whisker tooling help diagnose latency. However, the evidence shows only STT-stage numbers and guidance, not documented end-to-end voice-to-voice latency figures. Missing for 10: published end-to-end (mouth-to-ear) latency benchmarks, tuning guidance covering LLM/TTS/transport stages, independent latency measurements corroborating the speed claims.
